untertitel: Accounts, roles and groups of your FAH-NAS. Each account works for both the interface and the shares.
kopieren_fehl: Copying failed – please select the text and copy it yourself.
konto_passwort_erklaerung: Applies immediately to the interface and all shares. Other devices connected via SMB will then need the new password.
konto_totp_erklaerung: With 2FA, you also need a code from an authenticator app when signing in (e.g. Apple Passwords, Aegis, Google Authenticator). Protects your account if your password leaks.
konto_sitzungen_erklaerung: Each device (browser) you used in the last 30 days counts once – signing in again on the same device replaces the old sign-in. If you signed in on someone else's device, sign out all other devices here – this one stays.
konto_sitzungen_beendet: All other devices have been signed out.
passwort_alt_erklaerung: For security, enter your current password once more.
passwort_neu_erklaerung: At least 8 characters. Longer is better – a sentence with numbers and symbols is easy to remember and hard to guess.
passwort_wiederholung_fehler: The two passwords do not match.
passwort_kurz: The password needs at least 8 characters.
totp_schritt1: 1. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app
totp_schritt1_erklaerung: If scanning doesn't work, type the secret into the app manually instead.
totp_schritt2: 2. Enter the code from the app to confirm
totp_schritt2_erklaerung: This checks that the app is set up correctly. Only then is 2FA active.
totp_code_fehler: The code consists of exactly 6 digits.
totp_codes_erklaerung: If you lose your phone, you can get in with one of these codes. Each works once. Download or print them now and keep them safe – they will not be shown again.
totp_qr_fehl: The QR code could not be drawn. Please enter the secret manually.
totp_entfernen_erklaerung: Afterwards the password alone is enough again. For security, please enter your password.
keine: No users other than you yet.
abmelden_frage: End all sessions of “{name}”? The user will have to sign in again everywhere.
abgemeldet_meldung: All sessions of “{name}” have been ended.
name: Name
name_erklaerung: Lowercase, starts with a letter, 2–31 characters from a–z, 0–9, -, _ and dot (e.g. m.mustermann). Also becomes the Linux and SMB name; can be changed later.
name_erklaerung_aendern: Lowercase, 2–31 characters from a–z, 0–9, -, _ and dot. If you change it, the person signs in with the new name from now on – on the shares too; the password stays.
umbenennen_frage: Rename “{alt}” to “{neu}”? Permissions, personal folder, chats, office documents and share links move along. The person is signed out everywhere and signs in with “{neu}” afterwards; a mapped network drive \\NAS\{alt} has to be reconnected.
umbenennen_frage_selbst: Rename yourself to “{neu}”? Permissions, personal folder, chats and office documents move along. You will be signed out everywhere and sign in with “{neu}” and your current password.
umbenannt_selbst: You are now called “{neu}” – sign in with the new name in a moment.
name_fehler: User name: lowercase, starts with a letter, 2–31 characters from a-z, 0-9, -, _ and dot (not at the end, not doubled)
anzeigename_erklaerung: Free text for display, for example “Anna Muster”.
passwort_erklaerung: At least 8 characters. Share it with the user securely – they can change it under “My account”.
rolle_erklaerung: Admin can configure everything. User sees the dashboard, their own shares and files, and can change their own password and 2FA.
gruppen_erklaerung: Groups bundle users so you can grant share rights with a single checkbox.
gesperrt_erklaerung: A locked user can sign in neither to the interface nor to shares. Their files are kept.
sperren_frage: Lock user “{name}”? They will no longer be able to sign in.
passwort_setzen_erklaerung: The user gets the new password immediately. As admin, you don't need the old password.
loeschen_erklaerung: The account is removed from the interface, Linux and Samba. The last admin cannot be deleted.
loeschen_behalten_erklaerung: The user's files in the shares stay and will then belong to the admin.
loeschen_loeschen_erklaerung: All files owned by the user will be deleted irreversibly.
gruppen_untertitel: Share rights can be granted to groups instead of individual users.
gruppe_name_fehler: Group name: lowercase, starts with a letter, 2–31 characters from a-z, 0-9, - and _
gruppe_name_erklaerung: Lowercase, starts with a letter, 2–31 characters from a–z, 0–9, - and _. Appears as @name in shares.
gruppe_mitglieder_erklaerung: Check who belongs to the group. The change is saved per user.
gruppe_loeschen_frage: Delete group “@{name}”? Rights granted via this group will be removed.
totp_passwort_erklaerung: First confirm your current password. This way nobody with an open session can swap out the two-factor sign-in.
zugriff_admin: Admins have full access to all shares and work with root rights over SSH and SFTP, so they see the whole system there.
zugriff_erklaerung: Per share: no access, read only, or read and write. Rights via groups are shown on the right and apply in addition.
heim_erklaerung: A folder only for “{name}” – on the network as \\NAS\{name}.
heim_grenze_erklaerung: The most “{name}” may store in the folder; 0 = unlimited.
avatar_erklaerung: The picture appears next to the name everywhere – in the header, in chat, in calls and in Office. It is cropped to a square from the centre.
avatar_unlesbar: The browser cannot open this picture – please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
